items: A 50% deposit is due before work begins, and the other 50% before final handover or launch.
The Landing Page and Business Website packages include two consolidated rounds of revisions.
You supply approved text, brand assets and images, unless writing or creating them is quoted separately.
Domain registration, paid hosting, premium assets, subscriptions and third-party fees are not included unless the proposal says they are.
E-commerce, payment processing, custom backend systems and complex integrations need a separate assessment.
Changes outside the agreed scope need a revised quote and your approval before they are done.
Maintenance and ongoing support are separate services unless the proposal says they are included.
